Game Overview

In Loop Survivors Zombie City, the core idea is straightforward: survive relentless cycles in a zombie-infested world by battling waves of undead and mutants. Engage in strategic city-building and tactical loot collection, selecting random perks to enhance your hero. Overcome bosses, gather resources, and rebuild your city to unlock better combat opportunities in this action-packed adventure.

How to Play

Playing Loop Survivors Zombie City comes down to a simple loop. Survive relentless cycles in a zombie-infested world by battling waves of undead and mutants. Engage in strategic city-building and tactical loot collection, selecting random perks to enhance your hero. Overcome bosses, gather resources, and rebuild your city to unlock better combat opportunities in this action-packed adventure.
